verdict.rationale: Jitsu's design keeps data in your own infrastructure: it streams events into your own warehouse or storage (Postgres, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, S3, GCS) as standard tables, and profiles are also stored in your warehouse. It is 100% open-source and self-hostable, so leaving needs no export step, and workspace configuration is reachable through the Management API and jitsu-cli. Missing for 10: no documented export or offboarding procedure for Jitsu-held configuration and state, no evidence of how data buffered in Jitsu (e.g. Kafka, dead-letter queue) can be exported, and no independent hands-on report of migrating away.
